# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_TO_RIBBON_SUPPORT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In an established uptrend, a pullback to VWAP that finds support at a rising EMA ribbon and forms a bullish engulfing candle offers a high-probability long entry. This edge exists because it combines mean-reversion (VWAP as dynamic support) with trend-following (rising EMA ribbon) and candlestick confirmation (bullish engulfing), filtering for high-quality continuation moves in strong uptrends.

## Mechanism

Entry: Go long when all conditions are met on the same 5-minute bar:
- Price > EMA200 (uptrend filter)
- Low of bar touches VWAP within 0.1×ATR(14) (abs(low - VWAP) < 0.1×ATR(14))
- Price > EMA20 > EMA50 (rising EMA ribbon)
- Bullish engulfing candle (close > prior open AND open < prior close)

Exit:
- Primary stop: Chart stop at the most recent swing low (prior HH invalidation) or 0.75% premium stop, whichever is tighter
- Profit target: 2R (twice the risk) from entry
- Runner: Trail stop at 12% off the highest-high since entry to capture extended moves
- Time filter: Only active between 11:00-14:00 EST and when VIX < 22

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Strategy assumes $25K+ account for full position sizing (per risk rules: 15 contracts at $1.00 entry premium). $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to qty scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Conceptual proposal with zero historical samples; high overfit risk until validated on walk-forward data. Based on price action principles rather than data mining.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (requires walk-forward held-out window validation)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (requires realistic OPRA simulation on top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Whipsaw losses in ranging/choppy markets (false VWAP support)
   - Failed engulfing candles during low-volume periods
   - EMA ribbon false signals during abrupt regime shifts
   - VIX filter failure during volatility spikes (>22)
   - Time filter missing extended moves outside 11:00-14:00 window
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (requires top-5 days % of P&L calculation post-backtest)
